verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents its own background automation that runs once a user subscribes: automatic nexus monitoring with automated sales-tax filings and payments, continuous automatic book reconciliation, and compliance tracking with annual-report filings handled on the user's behalf. These are fixed, vendor-defined (and partly human-managed) services, not automations the user configures; no workflow builder, triggers, or rules engine is documented, and the API/OpenAPI probes found nothing. missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, custom triggers or schedules, programmatic or agent control of automations, independent corroboration that the automated filings run hands-off.
